sourceOccurrences.label: Closed separators, finite vertex witnesses and decreasing events
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Complete grouped deterministic source contracts with explicit certificate scope
sourceOccurrences.note: GA03 and 2C4E give the closed cluster boundary, stability of closed-boundary sets under connection, the first-exit walk argument and the two equivalent separator characterizations. The empty walk handles equal endpoints. NBY2 retains that the source finite-cluster witness is a finite vertex set. Finite coordinate certificates on a locally finite host are additional, and the unrestricted empty-configuration example prevents conflation. YIM4 keeps the root-in-set hypothesis. ZQI1 gives both deterministic decreasing properties; measurability on countable vertices is an additional deduction. These qualifications do not diagnose a false source theorem.

proofUses.reason: Cluster closure and the first edge leaving a vertex set give both separator characterizations.
The cluster is the finite vertex witness; local finiteness makes its host boundary finite.
A path leaving the prescribed set gives a forbidden edge from the root cluster to the complement.
Closing coordinates shrinks clusters. On countable vertices, nonconnection is a measurable complement and finite-cluster events are countable unions of closed-boundary events.
A definition; it invokes no other wiki assertion.
